name: Reuben
charge: Lying with Bilhah, his father's concubine
summary: Jacob's firstborn went up to his father's bed and lay with Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Nothing more is said until the deathbed, where it cost Reuben the birthright.
offense: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover (Leviticus 18:8), later a capital offense in the law. Chronicles states the consequence plainly (1 Chronicles 5:1-2): because he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph (1 Chronicles 5:1). Bilhah was his father's concubine, and Israel heard what Reuben had done (Genesis 35:22). The brief report is not an acquittal by silence. When Jacob gathered his sons, he first named the dignity and power that belonged to Reuben and then named the deed that cost him that excellence (Genesis 49:3-4).
judgment: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel. The double portion went to Joseph, the rule to Judah. Firstborn status did not shelter him from the consequence of defiling his father's bed (Genesis 49:3-4). Chronicles distinguishes the birthright from rulership: Joseph's sons received the birthright, while Judah prevailed above his brethren and from him came the chief ruler (1 Chronicles 5:1-2). Reuben remained a son and a tribe of Israel, but did not retain the privilege his place of birth had given him.

entries.commentary: Before going up to Bethel, Jacob told his household, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean. The strange gods were there because Rachel had stolen her father's images and hidden them, sitting on them when Laban searched. Idolatry hidden in the household must be put away before you can stand at Bethel. Rachel finally gave up the images, and Jacob hid them under the oak by Shechem. From Eve to Rachel the scriptures warn how sin enters through the household; of the woman came the beginning of sin. Sisters, stay in the spirit and guard against the serpent's beguiling as the mothers were beguiled.

The terror of God was upon the cities round about, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob. What Jacob feared after Shechem never came, because the angel of the Lord encamps round about them that fear Him and delivers them.

God appeared to Jacob again and confirmed it: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins. The nation and company of nations of Abraham's covenant is Israel, plain and clear, and kings come out of Israel's loins. Christ washed us from our sins and made us kings and priests unto God; the men of Israel are kings in the sight of the Most High. Israel once had mighty kings who ruled over countries beyond the river, and tribute and custom were paid unto them. The kings failed when they forsook the law, and their power was given to a strange nation; that is why the kings of the scriptures are not known as black kings today. When the King of kings returns He restores the crowns, and He sets crowns on the heads of the great multitude on mount Sion.
The land given to Abraham and Isaac was promised to Jacob and his seed: the land of Canaan, which is northeast Africa, the land the Most High named when He brought Israel out of Egypt.

Rachel travailed in hard labour and died bearing her second son; she called him Benoni, but his father called him Benjamin, the son of the right hand. He was the twelfth son, and Jacob set a pillar upon Rachel's grave in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Israel heard it. That is fornication such as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife. The judgment followed him: forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph, and the genealogy is not reckoned after the birthright. The firstborn lost the birthright over it.

Isaac gave up the ghost at an hundred and fourscore years, old and full of days, and his sons Esau and Jacob together buried him. --- Topics: [Esau and Edom](/encyclopedia/esau-and-edom) · [Idolatry](/encyclopedia/idolatry) · [The Covenant](/encyclopedia/the-covenant) · [The Priesthood](/encyclopedia/the-priesthood)

Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days. These blessings are twofold: they speak to what would come upon each tribe in their day and in the last days, and they help determine who the tribes are and where they would be found today.

Reuben is the so-called Seminole Indian today. Reuben, thou art my firstborn, the beginning of my strength: the firstborn is the father's posterity, and the excellency of dignity and the excellency of power belonged to him; the Seminoles were great warriors. Unstable as water: the Seminoles were nomads, always moving around, as the scripture said. Thou shalt not excel: Reuben would not excel as the firstborn, because he went up to his father's couch. His birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph because he defiled his father's bed, and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

Simeon is the so-called Dominican and Levi the so-called Haitian today. Simeon and Levi are brethren: all the tribes of Israel are brethren, but these two in particular were to dwell together, and they share the same island, Hispaniola. Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations: the witchcraft practiced on that island, such as the voodoo of Haiti. O my soul, come not thou into their secret: because of those practices the Most High does not unite them, and the two nations stay divided on the island even though Levi helped free Simeon from slavery. For in their anger they slew a man: when their sister was defiled at Shechem, they told all the men of the city to be circumcised, and while the men were sore they slew every male of the city. Simeon and Levi did not play. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel: Levi had no whole portion but cities scattered throughout all the tribes; and as Judah was scattered to the four corners of the earth, so was Levi, for Judah, Benjamin, and Levi make up the southern kingdom.

Judah is the so-called American Black man today. Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: Judah was the first to bring out this truth that we are the nation of Israel, and the great majority of the teachers of this truth today are of the kingdom of Judah. Thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies: Judah sits right in the neck of the enemy's kingdom, right up under Esau here in America, in his politics and his government, always in a key position. Thy father's children shall bow down before thee: Judah is the top tribe in the awakening today, for the Lord saves the tents of Judah first. Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up. The movements that stood up against the enemy in this land, that was Judah rebelling; then he stooped down and couched as an old lion, content, and only the Most High shall rouse him up. The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come: Shiloh means the peaceful one, Christ, who comes from the tribe of Judah, and unto him shall the gathering of the people be. Binding his foal unto the vine is the prophecy of Christ riding into Jerusalem upon the colt; and he washed his garments in wine and his clothes in the blood of grapes runs ahead to Christ returning from Bozrah with dyed garments, treading the winepress, to destroy Israel's enemies. His eyes shall be red with wine: Christ drank wine, so much that men called him a winebibber, but he was never drunken.

Zebulun is the so-called Mayan Indians today, from Guatemala down to Panama. Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and he shall be for an haven of ships: the Panama Canal sits in his land, built to shorten the trip around the world, and the ships of the earth must come through and dock there. His border shall be unto Zidon: as Zebulun dwelt by the sea in ancient Israel, so he dwells by the sea now; it was going to be the same, nothing different.

Issachar is the so-called Aztec Indian, the Mexican of today. Issachar is a strong ass: a hard worker, given over to hard work and known over the earth for labor. Couching down between two burdens: the two burdens are North America and Mexico, and the tribe sits pressed between them at the border, under the immigration laws, with even their children detained. He saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant: Mexico is a beautiful land. He bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute: hired out for cheap labor, and that labor is used to undercut and compete with Judah in the market.

Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel. Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward: Dan was like an ambush to the enemies, a powerful tribe that did not play. The tribe of Dan was absorbed into the other tribes, and chiefly into Benjamin; that is part of why Benjamin had so many slave revolts, and successful ones.

Gad is the so-called North American Indian, the Native American, today. Gad, a troop shall overcome him: the United States cavalry led by Andrew Jackson overcame Gad. But he shall overcome at the last: in the last days the tribe of Gad rises back up, as you see it rising now.

Asher is the so-called Incan Indians of South America, dwelling in the places from Colombia on down. Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties: Asher is known for resources, an abundance of natural riches in his land. The blessing of Moses says the same of Asher: let him dip his foot in oil.

Naphtali is the so-called Indians of Argentina and Chile today. Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words, and the capital of Argentina carries that mark, for Buenos Aires means good airs, goodly words.

Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well: Joseph, blessed in his sons Ephraim and Manasseh, is the so-called Puerto Ricans and Cubans today, a fruitful people. Whose branches run over the wall: the Spaniards built a wall in Puerto Rico to keep themselves separate, but the daughters went over the wall and mixed themselves among the people; interracial marriage ran high, and that is why a great part of them favor Esau today. The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: the Spanish conquistadors. But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob. The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors: they shall be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren; these are the blessings Ephraim and Manasseh received in [Genesis 48](/bible/genesis/48).

Benjamin is the so-called Jamaican today. Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: loud when he communicates, quick to anger, fierce; in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil. With Dan absorbed into him, Benjamin was dangerous in captivity; his slave revolts were plenty, and they were successful.

All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and their father blessed them, every one according to his blessing. The blessings tell who the tribes are and where they would be found in the last days. Jacob charged them to bury him with his fathers in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace, where Abraham and Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah, and Leah lie buried. When Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

Reuben was the firstborn of Israel, but because he defiled his father's bed his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, and the genealogy is not reckoned after the birthright. Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler, though the birthright was Joseph's, much as Esau came out first but did not keep the place of the heir. The sons and dwellings of Reuben are named down to Beerah, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive.

The sons of Gad are set down by the house of their fathers, dwelling in Gilead and Bashan and their towns. The record was reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel, keeping the account by name.

Reuben, Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh had valiant men able to bear buckler and sword and skillful in war, four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore that went to war. They made war with the Hagarites and were helped against them because they cried unto the Most High in the battle and put their trust in Him, and He was entreated of them. They took away much cattle and a hundred thousand captives, for the war was of the Most High; this is the curse of [Deuteronomy 28](/bible/deuteronomy/28) falling on the enemy instead of on us. -
The half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and mount Hermon, and they increased. The heads of the house of their fathers are named, mighty men of valour and famous men.

These tribes transgressed against the God of their fathers and went a-whoring after the gods of the people of the land whom the Most High had destroyed before them. The fringes commanded in Numbers were given so that we would look upon them and remember the commandments and not go a-whoring after our own eyes, which these tribes failed to do. Because of this the Most High stirred up the spirit of Pul, that is Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, who carried Reuben, Gad, and the half tribe of Manasseh into captivity unto this day. -

In Egypt the children of Israel served the gods of Egypt, dressed like Egyptians, and were fully engulfed in the Egyptian way of life; Moses himself was raised as an Egyptian in the house of Pharaoh. The Most High told them to leave all of that back in Egypt. The same word stands for us: when the Most High redeems us out of this captivity, many of the customs we learned here will be cut off, because they are not coming into the kingdom. The land of Canaan was full of idols. If Israel obeyed His voice the Most High would be an enemy to their enemies, bless their bread and water, and take sickness away; the charge in Canaan was not to bow to their gods nor do after their works, but to utterly overthrow them and break down their images. Coming out of Egypt required a transformed mind: not conformed to the way of life of Egypt or Canaan, but renewed to the commandments of the Most High.

Keep the statutes and judgments of the Most High, which if a man do, he shall live in them. The Ten Commandments are not the whole of the law but a summary. Under the Sabbath commandment sit sub-statutes such as no buying, no selling, no working; likewise under the law of adultery sit all the laws of this chapter, the ordinances of marriage and the forbidden beds. None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to uncover their nakedness; these laws name who a man may not lay down with.

The nakedness of thy father's wife is thy father's nakedness; that is the stepmother. The wicked mind reasons that she is not the biological mother, so it is fine to lust after her; the scripture says no, that is wicked. This very sin was reported among the Corinthians, a fornication not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife. The law had already forbidden it, and it was being done in Egypt and Canaan; that is why the Most High opened the chapter the way He did.

The sister, whether born at home or born abroad, and the son's daughter and the daughter's daughter are all forbidden; the grandchildren's nakedness is thine own nakedness. There are sick spirits out there, and some of them are grandfathers, uncles, and fathers. Be careful and mindful who you leave your children around; do not hand your children to just anybody for the sake of your own pleasure.

The father's sister, the mother's sister, and the wife of the father's brother, thine aunt, are all near kinswomen and off limits. Incest is still practiced among the nations of this land, and children born of incestuous unions often carry defects and disabilities; the law guards the seed.

The daughter in law, the brother's wife, and a woman with her daughter or her granddaughter are all forbidden; it is wickedness. Neither take a wife to her sister to vex her, to uncover her nakedness beside the other in her lifetime; that also shuts down what the world today calls threesomes.

A woman put apart for her uncleanness is a woman in her menstrual cycle. A man must wait the appointed seven days, and if the issue runs beyond, wait again; [Leviticus 15](/bible/leviticus/15) details these laws of uncleanness, taught in the previous class.
To lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife is adultery. This world even sings songs celebrating adultery; the law forbids defiling thyself with her.

Passing seed through the fire to Molech was child sacrifice: the nations slew their newborn children and offered them to that god, and Israel learned it from them, as Ezekiel testifies of Jerusalem slaying the children of the Most High. The abortions of today are no different. The Most High is bringing spirits into the earth, and the child is slain so the parents can go on living as they please; that is the same sacrifice unto Molech, and it is wickedness.

Abomination means a thing that causes disgust or hatred. When a man lies with mankind as with womankind, the Most High calls it disgusting and hateful. What a man hates and finds disgusting he removes far from himself; so we must teach our people to repent and come out of the things the Most High hates.
Lying with any beast is confusion, for man and for woman alike. The nations have set up places where these strange lusts are fulfilled, and the sin is found among every people; it is all wickedness.

In all these things the nations were defiled which the Most High cast out; the Egyptians and the Canaanites were doing these very abominations, and the land itself was defiled by them. The land spews out the defiled. That is why Israel was put out of Jerusalem: we could not abide in the land with our sins, sacrificing to idol gods and working all manner of evil, so the Most High raised up an enemy to carry us into bondage and remove us out of the land. Whosoever commits any of these abominations, the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people, meaning put to death.

Whosoever of Israel or of the strangers in the land gave of his seed unto Molech was surely put to death; the people of the land stoned him with stones. This is the child sacrifice shown in [Ezekiel 16](/bible/ezekiel/16), slaying the children of the Most High and delivering them to pass through the fire. If the people of the land hid their eyes from the man and killed him not, the Most High set His face against that man and against his family. When you see wickedness you must utter it and expose it; a witness that holds his peace bears iniquity. Sin brings judgment on a whole house. Achan coveted the goodly Babylonish garment, the silver, and the wedge of gold, and he and his sons and his daughters and all that he had were stoned and burned in the valley of Achor. What you do is not just about you; your sin can bring judgment on your family.

The soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, is cut off from among his people. Sanctify yourselves and be ye holy; keep the statutes of the Most High, for He is the Lord which sanctifieth you. Every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon him. Disrespecting your mother and your father carried the death penalty.

The man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress, shall surely be put to death. This world openly defends adultery and men even boast of committing it with another man's wife; the scriptures call for death upon both.

The man that lies with his father's wife, and the man that lies with his daughter in law, shall surely be put to death; they have wrought confusion. If a man lie with mankind as he lieth with a woman, both have committed an abomination and shall surely be put to death; abomination means hateful and disgusting unto the Most High. The man that takes a wife and her mother is burnt with fire, both he and they, that there be no wickedness among you. The man or woman that lies with a beast is put to death, and the beast is slain also. All of these judgments fall under the laws of adultery, the sub-statutes of that commandment.

The man that takes his sister and sees her nakedness, it is a wicked thing; they are cut off in the sight of their people, and he bears his iniquity. The man that lies with a woman having her sickness, her menstrual cycle, has discovered her fountain, and both are cut off from among their people; this goes with the laws of [Leviticus 15](/bible/leviticus/15). The nakedness of the mother's sister and the father's sister is near kin; they bear their iniquity. He that lies with his uncle's wife or takes his brother's wife, they shall die childless.

Keep all my statutes and all my judgments, that the land whither I bring you spew you not out. Walk not in the manners of the nation cast out before you, for they committed all these things and therefore the Most High abhorred them. I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people. The Most High separated Israel from the other people, so Israel is to walk differently; these laws are the separation.

Put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean; this goes back to [Leviticus 11](/bible/leviticus/11), the dietary laws. No shrimp, crab, lobster, pork, catfish, and the like; everything is not clean, whatever the church teaches. If you eat whatever you please, you are not separating yourself from the other nations. Ye shall be holy unto me, for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

A man or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, was surely put to death by stoning. The tarot card readings, the fortune telling, and the horoscopes of today are that same dealing with familiar spirits; do not touch any of it.

On the day Israel passed over Jordan into the land, they were to set up great stones, plaster them with plaster, and write upon them all the words of this law. Here is the difference between the truth and Islam and every other religion. The stone is not to be worshipped or thought to be a god; you set it up and put the laws on it so you can remember the laws.

The stones were to be set up in mount Ebal, and an altar of whole stones built there unto the Most High; no iron tool was to be lifted upon them. Burnt offerings and peace offerings were offered there, and the people were to eat and rejoice before the Most High. Thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly. That is what the Most High wants remembered most: not the stone itself, but the law written on it.

Moses and the priests the Levites told all Israel: this day thou art become the people of the Lord thy God; therefore obey his voice and do his commandments and statutes. Even the other nations' own books witness to it. The Martyrdom of Man says that "God made all men equal" is a fine sounding phrase but not a scientific fact, and that those who outlive hardships and sufferings which fall on all alike owe their existence to some superiority not only of body but of mind. There is no way we could have lasted this long through what we have been through if we were not the people of the Most High: thousands of years run out of the homeland, living among our enemies, put on ships and transported all over the world, and still surviving from 1492 on up here in Babylon the great.

Moses charged the people that day: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph (which is Ephraim and Manasseh), and Benjamin were to stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people. Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali were to stand upon mount Ebal to curse. Half the tribes stood on one side and half on the other, one saying one thing and the other answering.

The Levites were to speak with a loud voice unto all the men of Israel: cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the Most High, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen. Every curse that follows carried that same answer from the whole congregation.
Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. Setting light by them means disrespecting your parents and not obeying them.

Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. Every man in Israel was allotted a certain plot of land for his inheritance individually. If you moved that landmark trying to make your own land bigger, the Most High says cursed be upon you. The allotments are recorded in Joshua and in [Numbers 27](/bible/numbers/27), where the inheritance laws are given.
Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. Do not mistreat those we call the disabled.

Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. This goes back to Deuteronomy chapter 1, where the judges were charged to judge righteously between every man and his brother and the stranger with him, and to respect no persons in judgment.
Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife, because he uncovereth his father's skirt. That is nasty stuff, and the curse of the whole congregation stood against it.
Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. Bestiality is the practice of Esau, and Israel was cursed for touching it.
Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother. This goes back to Leviticus chapter 18, where the nakedness laws were first given.
Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law, and all the people shall say, Amen. Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly, and all the people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. That is your hitman right there in verse 25: taking payment to kill the innocent puts you under the curse.

Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. At that time this encompassed everything, including the law of sacrifice. It also applies to us today, because sacrifice is alive and well; it just transformed. We still sacrifice, only it is no longer animals but our bodies. Our bodies must be holy and without blemish before the Most High, because the law says you cannot bring anything with blemishes into the house of the Lord. If your sacrifice is not holy and acceptable, the Son is not taking you to present you before the Father. Christ magnified the law, as Isaiah says.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

Sexual relations to affinity of blood that require death.

text.text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
